title: Festive Fare: Caramelised Leek Puffs.
subtitle: Made to share – take a plate or dine in!
description: Make it an Australian festive season to remember with our selection of celebration finger food. Kick off the party with these tasty parcels of sweet leek, spinach and feta wrapped in crunchy fillo pastry.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 200C. Line a large oven tray with baking paper. Halve the leek lengthwise and thinly slice the pale stem, discarding any dark green stem. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Finely grate the zest of half the lemon.

Caramelise leek: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the leek and garlic, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add 2 tsp white wine vinegar and 2 tsp sugar and cook, stirring, for a further 1 min or until slightly caramelised. Add the spinach and stir until wilted. Transfer to a bowl.

Finish filling: Add the currants and lemon zest to the leek mixture, then cool slightly. Crumble in the feta. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Lay 1 fillo sheet on the bench and lightly brush or spray with olive oil (see Kitchen 101). Top with another fillo sheet, then repeat twice more with olive oil and fillo sheets.

Assemble triangles: Cut the fillo stack widthwise into 6 equal strips. Put 1 tbs filling on the short end of each strip. Fold over the pastry to form a triangle, then continue folding in a triangle shape to enclose the filling. Repeat with the remaining fillo strips. Repeat the process with another 4 fillo sheets and the remaining filling to make a total of 12 triangles.
Bake puffs: Put the triangles on the lined tray. Brush with 1 tbs olive oil, then scatter over the sesame seeds. Bake for 12-15 mins until puffed and golden. Enjoy! Makes 12 puffs (1 per serve).

Kitchen 101: For a more indulgent version, replace the olive oil spray with melted butter to brush over the fillo sheets. ~ While making the stacks and triangles, keep the fillo covered with a damp tea towel to prevent it from drying out.
